name: Transformer on the crossfader
lesson:
## Sixteenths on the crossfader

Crossfader hard right (deck A closed), then open on every sixteenth and closed on the next: 64 clicks across 4 bars at 95 BPM. Rest your hand so the thumb or index finger does the work and the fader travels only the few millimetres a sharp curve needs.

The transformer is the gateway to every fader scratch: it is the fader part of a chirp, a flare or a crab, done without the platter. What the scorer checks is the click count and their spacing; the cut itself should be under 100 ms. If your clicks bunch toward the beat, slow the tempo down rather than the pattern.

tracks.cue: The 'ahhh, fresh' sound on A, crossfader hard right; 64 clicks across 4 bars. Scratch material, so key is not matched.
Any skipless locked groove on the 100 side; the transformer pattern over a beat on B.
B supplies the beat under the transformer clicks.
